`horizontal` gives the x column the vertical axis and runs the value axis across the plot, where a bar is sized from the slot it stands in. `xAxis.type: "value"` hands out no slots, so it is ignored and "{0}" is drawn as categories.

`stacked: "normalized"` pins that value axis to 0-100, but series "{0}" stacks with nothing — a line never stacks, and a mark alone in its stack has no whole to be part of — so it draws its own numbers against that scale. Move it to `y2`, or stack it with the rest.
